review_candidates.title: Técnico de mantenimiento eólico - Huesca
review_candidates.description: Un Vistazo a tu día ¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Técnico de Turbinas Eólicas en Huesca! Imagina ser parte fundamental en el mantenimiento y la reparación de sistemas de turbinas eólicas, asegurando su disponibilidad operativa y rendimiento. En este rol, realizarás actividades de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, diagnósticos avanzados y análisis técnico, todo mientras cumples con los estándares de seguridad y calidad. Tu experiencia en sistemas mecánicos, hidráulicos y eléctricos de alta tensión será clave para resolver problemas complejos y garantizar un servicio de alta calidad en el sitio. Cómo Harás un Impacto Realizarás mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo programado en sistemas de turbinas eólicas, incluyendo componentes mecánicos, hidráulicos y eléctricos. Ejecutarás reemplazos y modificaciones de componentes mayores utilizando herramientas y equipos especializados. Escalarás turbinas para inspeccionar, diagnosticar y reparar equipos a gran altura, cumpliendo con los estándares de seguridad. Diagnosticarás y solucionarás fallas complejas en sistemas de control de turbinas, sistemas SCADA y circuitos eléctricos utilizando esquemas y equipos de prueba. Cumplirás estrictamente con todos los protocolos de Medio Ambiente, Salud y Seguridad (EHS), completando informes de servicio detallados y documentación de control de calidad. Lo Que Aportas Tienes un certificado de comercio eléctrico y un título de asociado o certificado técnico en un campo relevante como Tecnología de Energía Eólica, Electrónica o Mecánica. Posees experiencia comprobada en sistemas eléctricos de alta tensión y equipos mecánicos/hidráulicos complejos. Entiendes la lectura en inglés y tienes formación en electricidad, como un grado en mecatrónica o formación equivalente a un grado 2 de electricidad. Estás motivado y dispuesto a trabajar en altura, enfrentando desafíos a 100 metros de altura. Acerca del Equipo Formarás parte del equipo de Operaciones de Servicio Onshore en España, donde la misión es garantizar la disponibilidad y el rendimiento óptimo de los activos de turbinas eólicas. Este equipo se dedica a realizar mantenimientos, diagnósticos y reparaciones, asegurando que cada aspecto del servicio en el sitio se ejecute con la más alta calidad y seguridad. La colaboración y el apoyo mutuo son fundamentales, y tu experiencia será invaluable para enfrentar los desafíos técnicos que se presenten. ¿Quién es Siemens Gamesa? Siemens Gamesa es parte de Siemens Energy, un líder global en tecnología energética con un rico legado de innovación que abarca más de 150 años. Juntos, estamos comprometidos a hacer de la energía sostenible, confiable y asequible una realidad, desafiando los límites de lo posible. Como un actor principal en la industria eólica y fabricante de turbinas eólicas, nos apasiona impulsar la transición energética y proporcionar soluciones innovadoras que satisfagan la creciente demanda energética de la comunidad global. En Siemens Gamesa, estamos constantemente buscando individuos talentosos para unirse a nuestro equipo y apoyar nuestro enfoque en la transformación energética. Encuentra cómo puedes hacer la diferencia en Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemensenergy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html Nuestro Compromiso con la Diversidad Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Recompensas/Beneficios Aquí hay ejemplos de las recompensas y beneficios que ofrece Siemens Energy: Oportunidades para trabajar con un equipo global Oportunidades para trabajar y liderar una variedad de proyectos innovadores Beneficios médicos Tiempo libre/vacaciones pagadas y licencia parental Aprendizaje continuo a través de la plataforma Learn@Siemens-Energy Acceso a una variedad de grupos de recursos para empleados

review_candidates.location: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: For our Property Management function in Frederikshavn or Copenhagen, we are looking for a professional to play a key role in supporting and developing Property Management activities in Denmark. Reporting to the Head of Property Management, this position is responsible for technical building solutions across the Danish organization, while also coordinating and overseeing Property Management-related activities in Frederikshavn. For candidates based in Copenhagen, the role will include regular travel to Frederikshavn. Everllence’s Danish operations include production facilities, workshops, warehouses, administrative offices, and test centers across multiple locations. Property Management services are delivered through an external facility service provider, making supplier coordination planning, follow-up, and quality assurance important parts of the role. The focus is on ensuring that solutions and services are delivered efficiently and in line with business needs. The role also contributes to building and maintaining expertise in technical building solutions across the Danish organization. As such, an interest in standardization, optimization, automation, and digitalization will be valuable in supporting future improvements and creating long-term value. In addition, Everllence is currently developing new facilities in Roskilde, which will eventually replace the existing locations in Copenhagen and Holeby. This role will be closely involved in the project, providing technical expertise and contributing to the design and implementation of future facility solutions. You will play an important role in: Coordinating and managing Facility Management activities and projects Participating in coordination and performance review meetings with the external facility service provider Planning and executing smaller-scale projects Supporting the operation, maintenance, and development of technical building systems, including CTS/BMS across all sites Contributing to energy management and optimization initiatives Supporting environmental, occupational health and safety activities at site level We imagine that you: Have a background in electrical engineering, automation, marine engineering, or a related technical field will be valuable. The role requires technical expertise in automation and control systems, operations, and maintenance, ideally supported by several years of relevant experience. As this is a relatively independent role with responsibility for coordinating activities and stakeholders, experience leading projects, suppliers, or technical teams will be considered an advantage. The following qualifications and experience will be particularly relevant: Experience with operation and maintenance of buildings and technical installations Knowledge of and experience with BMS/CTS systems Experience with contract and supplier management A service-oriented mind mindset and ability to build strong stakeholder relationships Experience with project management To be successful in this role, strong planning and organizational skills are important, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a clear overview. A structured and systematic approach will support effective decision-making and help ensure that tasks are completed efficiently, safely, and according to business priorities. The role also requires strong collaboration and communication skills, as well as the ability to engage constructively with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organization. Fluency in written and spoken English and strong IT skills are required. Welcome to the Property Management Department Property Management is a team of five professionals responsible for supporting and developing our facilities across multiple locations. While many operational services are delivered through external partners, the department maintains broad responsibility for planning, coordination, governance, and continuous improvement of our facilities and workplace service. Each team member has dedicated areas of responsibility, and close collaboration across locations is an important part of how we work to ensure consistent and efficient service delivery. Together, the team manages a wide range of activities related to building operations and workplace services, including maintenance and development if facilities, canteen services, cleaning, outdoor areas, reception services, and mail handling. These services are delivered in close partnership with an external Facility service provider, with a focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. Unleash your potential at Everllence Join us on our journey toward a carbon‑neutral future. At Everllence, you will help shape innovative energy solutions while growing your skills and advancing your career. We prioritize work-life balance, flexible working hours and remote work options. We value creativity, diversity, well‑being, and have a wide range of social clubs -from yoga and fishing to creative activities. In 2027, we will unite our Copenhagen and Holeby locations at a new and modern site in Trekroner, Roskilde. Build your future with us Please apply before Wednesday, September the 30, 2026. Interviews will be held during the application period. Questions? You are welcome to contact Karsten Thiesen, Head of Property Management, Denmark at +45 40139340. Relocating to Denmark? We support you with a mobility package, including help with CPR registration, tax, and work permits. We aim for a fair and inclusive recruitment process. Regardless of gender, age, religion, disability, or ethnic background, we encourage you to apply. We embrace a global mindset and intercultural environment to ensure a collaborative and inclusive workplace. If you need support, such as assistive tools for dyslexia, we can assist you.
